words.definition: The state of being accountable; liability to be called on to render an account

words.definition: The state or quality of having supreme authority and power

words.definition: The act of working together for a common goal

words.definition: Relating to the promotion of human welfare

words.definition: The act or process of governing

words.definition: Relating to or characteristic of an institution

words.definition: A human society with a high level of cultural and technological development

sentence.sentence: The development of civilization is a long and complex process.
sentence.translation: सभ्यता का विकास एक लंबी और जटिल प्रक्रिया है।

words.definition: The process of growing or developing

sentence.sentence: The country's economic development has been rapid in recent years.

sentence.sentence: Sustainable development is essential for the future of our planet.
sentence.translation: हमारे ग्रह के भविष्य के लिए स्थायी विकास आवश्यक है।

words.definition: The process of global integration and interdependence

sentence.sentence: Globalization has led to increased economic interdependence among nations.

sentence.sentence: The impact of globalization on local cultures is a topic of debate.
sentence.translation: स्थानीय संस्कृतियों पर वैश्वीकरण का प्रभाव एक विवाद का विषय है।

words.definition: The state of being dependent on each other
words.definationTranslation: एक दूसरे पर निर्भर होने की स्थिति

sentence.sentence: The interdependence of nations is a key feature of globalization.

sentence.sentence: The interdependence of economies has led to increased trade.
sentence.translation: अर्थव्यवस्थाओं की परस्पर निर्भरता ने व्यापार में वृद्धि की है।

words.definition: The process of becoming more international in scope or application
words.definationTranslation: अधिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर या अनुप्रयोग में बनने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.translation: व्यवसाय का अंतरराष्ट्रीयकरण हाल के वर्षों में बढ़ा है।

sentence.sentence: Internationalization is a key strategy for companies to expand globally.

words.definition: The process of making something more liberal or free

words.definition: The process of becoming more modern

sentence.sentence: The modernization of infrastructure has improved the quality of life.

sentence.sentence: Modernization is a key factor in economic development.

sentence.sentence: The regulation of financial markets is essential for economic stability.

sentence.sentence: Regulation of environmental pollution is necessary for public health.
sentence.translation: पर्यावरण प्रदूषण का नियमन सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य के लिए आवश्यक है।

words.definition: A person or group with an interest or concern in something
words.definationTranslation: किसी चीज़ में रुचि या चिंता रखने वाला व्यक्ति या समूह

sentence.sentence: The stakeholders of the company include employees, customers, and investors.
sentence.translation: कंपनी के हितधारकों में कर्मचारी, ग्राहक और निवेशक शामिल हैं।

sentence.translation: हितधारक निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रियाओं में एक महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं।
